invariants: each record payload matches exactly the contract selected by record.kind
integer payload values are nonnegative safe integers unless the selected field explicitly allows signed values
error-code and error-category values exist in error-codes.json and correspond
input content remains redacted unless trace.redaction.fullContent is true
record.sequence values are unique and strictly increasing as unsigned 64-bit integers

when records is nonempty rootCorrelation.initialSequence equals the first retained record sequence; when records is empty it identifies the next root sequence; every record belongs to rootCorrelation.contextId directly or through an earlier causal identity
record.timestampNanos values are nondecreasing in record order

each correlation object contains the kind-required identity: context for input, eventId for Event, commandId for Command, effectSpanId for Effect span, transactionId for transaction or mutation, componentId for reconcile/layout/text, renderRequestId for render/diff/terminal write, and at least one causal identity for error or cleanup
every correlation identity references an earlier retained record or an explicit root identity declared by the Trace header; links cannot point forward
wrapCount greater than zero permits missing predecessors only before the first retained sequence and requires one unattributed boundary record

redaction.fullContent true requires input, clipboard, and terminalPayloads to equal included; replay.runtime and replay.applicationInput to equal available; and encoded Event batches, committed transaction bytes, and mutation values; fullContent false requires those redaction fields and both replay states to equal redacted and forbids encoded fields
encoded replay fields decode from canonical base64 into exact ABI 2.0 Event batches, transaction batches, or resource-specific mutation payloads and pass the same validators used by live input
runtime replay rejects a record kind whose registered payload contract or migration is unavailable
